subject.title: Legacy channel credential files bypass account-scoped degradation

question: Which owner should confirm the canonical shared account-unavailable contract and coordinate the affected legacy channel resolvers before implementation?
rationale: The report spans several owner plugins and a Gateway degradation invariant; the protected maintainer label requires explicit routing rather than automated repair dispatch.

options.title: Assign a cross-channel owner
options.body: Confirm the shared typed-unavailable contract, then land one coordinated bounded fix with resolver and Gateway-sibling coverage.

options.title: Split by channel owner
options.body: Keep a shared contract specification but have each affected channel owner repair and test its own resolver.

recommendation.title: Assign a cross-channel owner
recommendation.body: Confirm the shared typed-unavailable contract, then land one coordinated bounded fix with resolver and Gateway-sibling coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter supplied the intended compatibility and degradation contract, pending identification of code-history owners.
